name: Blender
summary: Kitchen jug blender on a motor base with fruit in the jug; anim blend swirls and shakes the contents.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the blender stands on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (about 400 px tall); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: color2
params.note: fruit colour of the contents (pink = strawberry, orange = mango, green = kale)

params.name: anim
params.note: blend = contents swirl, fruit pieces orbit and the blade spins

author: krakujs
